classification_basis.exact_mutation_boundary: The adapter fails closed unless POST /v1/correct acknowledges the selected unit or POST /v1/forget acknowledges every selected unit.
classification_basis.method: Per-case operation-boundary root-cause adjudication consumes the recorded error kind, failed assertion indexes, adapter decisions, exact selected IDs, mutation receipts, and created/superseded IDs.
classification_basis.purge_na: MemPhant exposes subject erasure and exact-unit forget, not selective hard purge by natural-language query.
classification_basis.release_failures: Natural-language multi-target deletion is destructive and ambiguous; it requires proposal plus explicit confirmation before exact-ID forget.
classification_basis.supersession_failures: The public exact-ID correction primitive succeeded; natural-language target choice or compound-fact merge planning was the adapter gap.
